display_name: PTI Phúc An Sinh health care insurance rules (Decision 267/QĐ-PTI-BHCN, 26 September 2012), the whole document: definitions, Programmes I and II, optional benefits 1-6, 32 exclusions, general conditions, claims procedure

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the deposited text rendering, and in short runs elsewhere that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md maps each Vietnamese term to its English identifier.

documents.authority: the insurer's own publication of its standard-form rules (pti.com.vn, upload path dated 2025/01); private contract terms, not law

aids.use: read only, to tag LAW forks; not encoded

scope: The whole document as published at its URL on 2026-10-06: Part 1 (51 definitions), Part 2 (Programme I, Programme II benefits 1-3 and its other benefits, optional benefits 1-6), Part 3 (32 exclusions), Part 4 (clauses 1-11, with the short-period scale), Part 5 (time limits, forfeiture, every document list, form of documents, direct billing). Inputs, not gaps: every figure of the certificate and of Appendix 01 (the Rules print no money figure), the rate of Appendix 03 for a listed disablement, membership of the Appendix 04 network. Appendices 01, 03 and 04 are not in the published file (out-of-scope rows). Declined by named REFUSE: a partial disablement Appendix 03 does not list, the renewal premium by age band, the day of last treatment where there was no stay and no outpatient treatment, an unsubmitted claim file, PTI's time to pay, a medical disagreement with no arbitrator. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: The text encoded is the published file as retrieved; the 2022 Law postdates it and is not encoded.
forks.F2: Cover begins on the later of the certificate's first day and the day after full premium.
forks.F3: On continuous renewal, waiting periods, pre-existing conditions and exclusions 12 and 26 run from the date of joining (definition 5 alone: finding X3).
forks.F5: Part 4 clause 1 bars are tested at the start of each period.
forks.F6: Epilepsy bars Programme I cover only.
forks.F7: A waiting period counts the first day of cover as day 1, and the treatment date governs.
forks.F8: An occupational disease is an illness for clause 5.
forks.F9: Programme I's 104 weeks are tested on the onset of a disablement (finding X1).
forks.F10: Appendix 03 gives a percentage of the sum insured.
forks.F11: Programme II's other benefits are for illness only.
forks.F12: Definition 17's 52 weeks means at least 52 weeks.
forks.F13: Definition 21's three years end at the start date.
forks.F14: Transport by ambulance to an appropriate place, not the nearest.
forks.F15: Days of a stay are counted inclusively.
forks.F16: Definition 33's list of medical expenses is closed.
forks.F17: Sailing is dangerous only beyond 5 km from shore.
forks.F19: Cancellation notice must be sent at least 30 days before the day of cancellation.
forks.F20: Unexpired premium is the annual premium less the short-period charge for the time run, in calendar months.
forks.F21: Part 4 clause 6: the larger of the excess and ratio methods (Law art 24).
forks.F22: The ratio method uses the limit for the benefit claimed.
forks.F23: LAW: subrogation clause encoded as written despite Law art 16(4) and art 38.
forks.F24: Occupational-disease costs share Programme I's medical heads and limit.
forks.F25: Costs before admission: the 30 days before the day of admission.
forks.F26: The Asia extension widens the whole contract's scope.
forks.F27: Newborn care is co-paid and counts against its own limit and benefit 4's.
forks.F28: Benefit 4(b) waiting periods govern benefit 4 only; none for newborn care.
forks.F29: The income allowance age test is on the day of admission.
forks.F30: Benefit 6's cancer bar applies to a person with cancer at the period's start, with no continuity proviso.
forks.F31: Exclusion 2's first limb does not reach traffic offences (finding X7).
forks.F32: Exclusion 9's proviso on vaccination after an accident or bite limits its vaccination limb (finding X8).
forks.F34: Benefit 2's life-sustaining prosthesis prevails over exclusion 18 (finding X4).
forks.F35: Exclusion 27 does not reach benefits granted for treatment outside a stay (finding X5).
forks.F36: Financial, medical and other documents are classified by what each is.
forks.F37: 'Within N days from day X' ends on day X + N.
forks.F38: Network stays need no documents from the insured; the daily allowance is proved by the discharge paper; a taxi has none listed.
forks.F39: Further medical information is due within the 120 days of clause 1.
forks.F40: Forfeiture follows late filing or late further documents, not a late notice (finding X2).
forks.F41: LAW: 180 days from last treatment encoded as written, despite Law art 30 (one year from the event).
forks.F42: LAW: no time for PTI to pay; refused by name; Law art 31's 15 days not encoded.
forks.F43: LAW: PTI's free cancellation encoded as written, despite Law art 26.
forks.F44: Exclusion 26's first year runs from the start date of F3.
forks.F45: Death, total and partial disablement share one sum insured.
forks.F46: One main limit per programme; optional benefits count only against their own limits.
forks.F47: For illness, the treatment (for Programme II the admission) must fall in the period, not the onset.
forks.F48: Definitions 27 and 28 are encoded literally, excluding different places.
forks.F49: Buying the dental benefit lifts the whole of exclusion 25.
forks.F50: A traffic accident is serious if it caused death or involved a third party, or is otherwise stated serious.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests modules was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the Rules' words and the fixtures' hypothetical figures.
